items.definition: Impersonates a recruiter or employer to obtain money, data, or access.
items.name: Recruiter impersonation

items.definition: Advertises a role that does not exist or materially misrepresents the employer.
items.name: Fake job advertisement

items.definition: Offers paid rating or optimisation tasks before demanding deposits to continue or withdraw.
items.name: Task or optimisation scam

items.definition: Uses an easy remote-work promise to collect fees or personal information.
items.name: Work-from-home data-entry scam

items.definition: Requires payment before an application, interview, or job can proceed.
items.name: Registration or processing-fee scam

items.definition: Requires payment for mandatory training, licensing, or certification controlled by the scammer.
items.name: Training or certification-fee scam

items.definition: Directs the applicant to buy equipment from a fake supplier or send money for reimbursement.
items.name: Equipment-purchase scam

items.definition: Sends a false payment and instructs the applicant to return or forward real funds.
items.name: Fake-cheque or overpayment scam

items.definition: Recruits a person to receive and forward goods acquired through fraud.
items.name: Reshipping or parcel-mule job

items.definition: Recruits a person to receive, convert, or forward criminal proceeds.
items.name: Money-mule or payment-agent recruitment

items.definition: Uses shopping assignments, fake cheques, or gift-card purchases to steal funds.
items.name: Mystery-shopper scam

items.definition: Impersonates a public body and charges for placement, forms, or clearance.
items.name: Government-job placement scam

items.definition: Promises overseas employment while charging for visas, travel, or placement.
items.name: Visa or overseas-placement scam

items.definition: Uses recruitment as a pretext to obtain identity, banking, or authentication data.
items.name: Employment identity harvesting

items.definition: Directs the applicant to install unsafe software or open a malicious interview file.
items.name: Interview malware or fake meeting application

items.definition: Uses deceptive overseas employment to facilitate coercion, confinement, or forced criminal activity.
items.name: Labour-trafficking recruitment

items.definition: Builds friendship or romance before directing the victim to a controlled investment platform.
items.name: Relationship-investment scam

items.definition: Uses a coordinated group, fake experts, and fabricated testimonials to induce deposits.
items.name: Fake investment chat group

items.definition: Displays fabricated balances and profits on a platform controlled by the scammer.
items.name: Fake trading website or application

items.definition: Promotes a false crypto, token, mining, staking, or liquidity opportunity.
items.name: Cryptocurrency or token investment scam

items.definition: Promotes unauthorised or fictitious leveraged trading with unrealistic returns.
items.name: Forex or CFD trading scam

items.definition: Claims an automated or AI system produces consistent low-risk profits.
items.name: AI or automated trading-bot scam

items.definition: Promises implausible fixed daily, weekly, or monthly investment returns.
items.name: High-yield guaranteed-return programme

items.definition: Uses new participants' money to pay apparent returns to earlier participants.
items.name: Ponzi scheme

items.definition: Rewards recruitment and entry fees rather than genuine investment activity.
items.name: Pyramid or investment-MLM scheme

items.definition: Promotes a security using false claims before insiders sell at an inflated price.
items.name: Pump-and-dump or stock-tip manipulation

items.definition: Offers fictitious or unauthorised shares before an alleged public listing.
items.name: Pre-IPO or private-placement scam

items.definition: Misuses the identity of a regulated firm or professional to solicit investments.
items.name: Clone-firm or adviser impersonation

items.definition: Exploits a shared community, religion, occupation, or nationality to build trust.
items.name: Affinity investment fraud

items.definition: Promotes fictitious or misrepresented gold, commodity, or futures investments.
items.name: Commodity or precious-metal fraud

items.definition: Offers non-existent, unauthorised, or materially misrepresented property investments.
items.name: Real-estate or land investment fraud

items.definition: Targets prior victims with a promise to recover losses after another advance payment.
items.name: Recovery or reload scam
